Strategy Performance

Six repeatable insider-buying strategies · Adjusted prices through Aug 20, 2026
Each report can open an equal-weight basket of up to five securities, ranked by combined insider-buy size or combined score. A selected security cannot be bought again while its position is open, but it becomes eligible for a new position once that strategy's holding period ends. Expand any period below to audit every open, closed, or price-pending position.
Methodology and safeguards
  • Entry: Next trading day's adjusted open after the report
  • Exit: Adjusted close on the first trading day on or after the calendar holding period
  • Allocation: Equal dollars per security and equal weight per report cohort
  • Evaluation window: Cohorts whose report date falls within the trailing window
  • Sharpe: Annualized from equal-weight daily cohort returns with a 0% risk-free rate
  • Half-Kelly: Half-Kelly from absolute winners and losers; minimum 5 closed positions
